Part of Radar's Renegade Rugged Terrain range, it sits between an all-terrain and a mud-terrain to give you the best of both worlds — go-anywhere rough-terrain bite on the weekend and a quiet, composed ride during the week. This 275/65R18 fitment combines tough off-road grip with dependable on-road comfort, making it a smart choice for South African 4x4, SUV and bakkie owners who demand more from their tyres. Wide, stable centre blocks – Balanced weight distribution gives confident highway stability and even, long-lasting treadwear. Dual sidewall design – Mud-penetrating dagger lugs on one side and wedge-shaped lugs on the other add sidewall bite and extra protection. Quiet, smooth ride – Refined tread geometry keeps road noise low for a civilised drive between trips. Go-anywhere confidence – Matches a dedicated mud-terrain in the rough while staying controlled on the road. description: Radar Renegade R/T+ – rugged-terrain grip with on-road manners The Radar Renegade R/T+ in is a rugged-terrain (R/T) 4x4 tyre engineered for drivers who want serious off-road capability without giving up on-road comfort. Part of Radar's Renegade Rugged Terrain range, it sits between an all-terrain and a mud-terrain to give you the best of both worlds — go-anywhere rough-terrain bite on the weekend and a quiet, composed ride during the week. This fitment combines tough off-road grip with dependable on-road comfort, making it a smart choice for South African 4x4, SUV and bakkie owners who demand more from their tyres. Key features & benefits Rugged-terrain tread design – Aggressive tread blocks, multiple lateral grooves and angled sipes deliver superb traction on gravel, mud, rock and tar. Reinforced 3-ply casing – Robust construction resists punctures and keeps you sure-footed over sharp stones and broken ground. Wide, stable centre blocks – Balanced weight distribution gives confident highway stability and even, long-lasting treadwear. Dual sidewall design – Mud-penetrating dagger lugs on one side and wedge-shaped lugs on the other add sidewall bite and extra protection. Quiet, smooth ride – Refined tread geometry keeps road noise low for a civilised drive between trips. Go-anywhere confidence – Matches a dedicated mud-terrain in the rough while staying controlled on the road.
